Lemma
[uniform curvature and backward existence on bounded rescaled balls] Source: cao-zhu ↗ lem:cz-backward-control-or-capwise-comparability 1. Assertion 4 in Step 3 of Lemma 7.4.2\group Canonical-Neighborhood Induction Given any subsequence of the rescaled solutions $\tilde{g}^{\alpha _k\beta _k}_{ij}$ with $r^{\alpha _k}\rightarrow 0$ and $\delta ^{\alpha _k\beta _k}\rightarrow 0$ as $k\rightarrow \infty $, then for any $L>0$, there are constants $C(L)>0$ and $k(L)$ such that the rescaled solutions $\tilde{g}^{\alpha _k\beta _k}_{ij}$ satisfy

  • $\tilde{R}(x,0)\leq C(L)$ for all points $x$ with $\tilde{d}_{0}(x,\bar{x})\leq L$ and all $k \geq 1$;

  • the rescaled solutions over the ball $\tilde{B}_{0}(\bar{x},L)$ are defined at least on the time interval $[-\frac{1}{16}\eta ^{-1}C(L)^{-1},0]$ for all $k\geq k(L)$.
